observations: Photo 0 shows a black manual sewing machine with gold/yellow decorative patterns and text. The brand name 'BUTTERFLY' is visible in gold lettering on the side.
The machine has a large handwheel on the right, a metal base, and a needle bar assembly. It appears to be an older model, possibly vintage.
Photo 1 shows the same sewing machine placed on a reddish-brown wooden table with metal legs. The table has a worn surface and a metal foot pedal underneath.
The environment appears to be a dimly lit, possibly outdoor or semi-outdoor space with concrete flooring and some clutter in the background.
No power cord or electrical components are visible, consistent with a manual machine.
The machine shows signs of use: some dust, minor scratches, and wear on the paint and metal parts.

claims.claim: Neatly used Butterfly manual Sewing machine
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the brand 'BUTTERFLY' clearly. The machine appears to be manual (no motor or plug visible). Signs of use are present but not excessive, consistent with 'neatly used'.

No proof of current working condition. No photos of internal mechanisms, needle movement, or test stitching. The seller claims it can be serviced, but no evidence of service history or current functionality.

risks.risk: Machine may not work due to internal wear, broken parts, or rusted mechanisms
risks.proof: A close-up video or photo showing the needle moving up and down when the handwheel is turned, and a test stitch on fabric.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged parts (e.g., presser foot, bobbin case, needle, or foot pedal)
risks.proof: Photo showing all components laid out, including the foot pedal, needle, presser foot, and bobbin case.

risks.risk: Structural damage to the table or base that affects stability or usability
risks.proof: Photo showing the underside of the table and base, and a close-up of the metal legs and joints.

proof_requests: Video or photo of the machine in operation: handwheel turning, needle moving, and test stitch on fabric.
Photo showing all included parts: foot pedal, needle, presser foot, bobbin case, and any accessories.
Close-up of the machine’s base and table legs to check for rust or damage.
response.reason: The brand and type are identifiable, but the working condition and completeness are unverified. Without proof of operation and included parts, the item cannot be priced accurately. The risks of non-functionality or missing components are significant and must be resolved before pricing.
